footnotes: a. Within 42 days of ALXN1840 administration. Details of procedures that may be performed by sites designated as "screening sites" (only in the US) are detailed in Section 8.
b. Participants will be admitted to the clinical research unit (CRU) at least 10 hours prior to enrollment and initiation of copper_ and molybdenum_controlled diet.
c. At the CRU's discretion, participants may remain in the CRU or be readmitted on Day 22 with all procedures starting on Day 23.
d. Unscheduled study visits may occur at any time during the study and may include any study procedure as deemed necessary by the Investigator.
e. Participants are required to return to the CRU Day 54+/_2; participants will be discontinued from ALXN1840 medication by their physician at the latest by the Day 54 follow_up.

f. Discharge from the unit may occur after completion of all procedures on Day 9 and on Day 40 and after the Investigator has reviewed all safety assessment (including safety laboratory tests) and confirmed that the participant is appropriate for discharge.

g. A single outpatient visit or phone call and safety laboratory assessment should occur between Day 14 and Day 18. A phone call may take place on a different day than the blood draw within the Day 14 through Day 18 period.
h. If needed to confirm menopause.
i. Parameters include age and sex. Race and ethnicity will be collected where permitted by local regulations.
j. Wilson disease history will include diagnosis date, method of diagnosis, history of cirrhosis, details of any previous liver biopsies performed, and treatment received.

k. A full physical examination will be performed at Screening, at check_in for the study, and at the End of the study/Early Termination Visit. A physical examination should also be performed on any participants with ongoing adverse events prior to discharge from the unit. Otherwise, a symptom_driven physical examination may be performed at other times, at the Principal Investigator's discretion.
l. Height at screening only.

m. While in the CRU, study intervention will be administered after an overnight fast (ie, at least 10 hours) at the same time every morning; drug is to be administered with 240 mL of water and meals should be delayed a minimum of 2 hours after dosing. As an outpatient, participants are expected to take ALXN1840 at approximately the same time daily (+/_1 hour). Participants should take the medication with a glass of water on an empty stomach; meals should be delayed a minimum of 2 hours after dosing.
n. During the outpatient period, participants will use SMS text messaging to confirm study intervention administration.
o. Blood sampling for PK/PD will occur before ALXN1840 administration and represents a predose trough. See Table 2 for PK/PD sampling on Days 1, 25, 29, and 39.
p. PK/PD collection will include timepoints described in the schedule of PK/PD assessment for Days 1, 25, 29, and 39 (Table 2).

q. Samples for serum chemistry will be obtained following a fast of at least 8 hours at the Screening Visit and at check_in. In case of rechecks, and postdose serum chemistry, participants may not have fasted for 6 or 8 hours before the serum chemistry sample is taken.
r. Laboratory assessment including chemistry, hematology, and coagulation parameters should be performed on Days _8, _1, 8, 23, and 28 only.

s. Menstruation check for women only; women of childbearing potential should only be enrolled after a negative serum pregnancy test result at Screening. Additional urine pregnancy testing will be standard for the protocol unless serum testing is required by site policies, local regulation, or Institutional Review Boards (IRBs)/Independent Ethics Committees (IECs) (Section 10.2). In addition to pregnancy tests detailed at the visits in the SoA, females of childbearing potential will be required to perform urine pregnancy tests at least every 4 weeks at their home or the study site throughout their time in the study.
t. A single 15 mL serum sample will be retained for evaluation in the event of an unexpected safety finding; retained samples may be destroyed after completion of the clinical study report.

u. Vital signs measurements and ECGs should be performed predose, unless otherwise specified. Vitals signs include body temperature, heart rate, respiratory rate, and systolic and diastolic blood pressure.

v. Copper_ and molybdenum_controlled diet will be initiated after registration/inclusion. Participants will remain on a copper/molybdenum controlled diet throughout both the inpatient Period 1 (Day _8 to Day 9) and inpatient Period 2 (Day 23 to Day 40); during this time participants will be strongly encouraged to complete all meals. While not in the CRU, participants will be encouraged to adhere to their usual copper_controlled diet.
w. For each input/output balance period, 24_hour urine samples are to be collected for measurement of copper and molybdenum.
x. For fecal samples, each individual sample will be independently collected with record of date, time, and weight of the sample.

data.name: Height, Weight, and BMI Measurement
data.label: Anthropometric Measurements
data.description: Measurement of height (at Screening only), weight, and calculation of BMI at specified timepoints

data.name: Blood Sampling for PK/PD Analysis

code.decode: Collection of venous blood by venipuncture for PK/PD analysis

data.label: PK/PD Blood Sampling
data.description: Serial blood sampling for pharmacokinetic and pharmacodynamic analysis on Days 1, 25, 29, and 39 at timepoints: _0.5, 0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 8, 12, and 24 hours relative to dosing; predose trough samples collected on other days

data.name: Intravenous Cannula
data.label: IV Cannula
data.description: Peripheral venous cannula placed to minimize needle sticks during repeated blood draws for PK/PD sampling; must not be left in place longer than 72 hours and must be flushed a minimum of every 8 hours

data.name: Automated Blood Pressure Device
data.label: Automated BP Monitor
data.description: Completely automated device used for blood pressure and heart rate measurements; manual techniques used only if automated device is not available

data.name: 12_Lead ECG Machine
data.label: ECG Device
data.description: Device used to perform triplicate 12_lead electrocardiograms to assess heart rate, PR, QRS, QT, and QTcF intervals at scheduled timepoints

data.name: ICP_MS Instrument
data.label: ICP_MS
data.description: Inductively coupled plasma mass spectrometry instrument used to determine copper and molybdenum concentrations in food, fluid, urine, and fecal samples

data.name: Large Water Bottle Dispenser
data.label: Water Dispenser
data.description: Shared large water bottle dispenser from which all participants drink during inpatient periods; water samples collected and analyzed for copper and molybdenum content

data.name: Age requirement
data.text: Participants aged ≥18 at the time of signing the ICF.

data.name: Wilson Disease diagnosis
data.text: Diagnosis of WD by Leipzig Criteria ≥ 4 documented by testing as outlined in the 2012 European Association for the Study of Liver WD Clinical Practice Guidelines (Ferenci, 2003; EASL, 2012) or by historical test results for WD including some or all of the following: Presence of Kayser Fleischer rings, Neurological symptoms, Serum ceruloplasmin below reference range, Coombs_negative hemolytic anemia, Elevated liver or urinary copper, Presence of mutations in the ATP7B gene, or Other, as considered appropriate, may be used instead to confirm the diagnosis of WD.

data.name: Benefit from decoppering therapy
data.text: Participants who in the opinion of the referring Investigator may benefit from decoppering therapy.

data.name: Ability to comply with study procedures
data.text: Participants must be able to comply with all study_related procedures.

data.name: Ability to reside in CRU
data.text: Participants must be able to reside in the CRU for intensive metabolic monitoring of copper and molybdenum.

data.name: Willingness to discontinue chelator therapy
data.text: Participants willing to discontinue chelator therapy for approximately 4 days prior to initiation of ALXN1840 to allow a baseline assessment of copper balance.

data.name: Adequate venous access
data.text: Participants with adequate venous access to allow collection of required blood samples.

data.name: Ability to swallow tablets
data.text: Participants must be able to swallow intact ALXN1840 tablets.

data.name: Willingness to avoid copper/zinc/molybdenum minerals
data.text: Participants willing to avoid use of minerals containing copper, zinc, or molybdenum throughout the study duration.

data.name: Willingness to adhere to controlled diet
data.text: Participants willing to adhere to copper/molybdenum_controlled diet during inpatient periods and willing to comply with a low copper dietary requirement during the Outpatient Period.

data.name: Contraceptive use requirement
data.text: Contraceptive use by men or women should be consistent with local regulations regarding the methods of contraception for those participating in clinical studies. Male participants: Male participants, if heterosexually active and with a female spouse or partner of childbearing potential or a pregnant or breastfeeding spouse or partner, must agree to use barrier contraception (male condom) for the duration of the study and for at least 3 months after the end of systemic exposure of the study intervention. Male participants must not donate sperm for at least 3 months after the end of systemic exposure of the study intervention. Female spouses or partners of male participants who are of childbearing potential must use highly effective contraception as defined in Section 10.4, starting at least 1 menstrual cycle before (the male participant's) first study intervention administration and continuing until at least 3 months after the end of their male partner's systemic exposure to the study intervention. Barrier contraception (male condom) is required even with documented medical assessment of surgical success of a vasectomy. For male participants who have had a vasectomy (with documented evidence of azoospermia if possible) and agree to use a male condom for the stated time period, no additional contraceptive method is required by their female partner. Female participants: Female participants or female partners of male participants of childbearing potential (including breastfeeding females), if heterosexually active, must be willing to follow protocol_specified contraception guidance starting at least 1 menstrual cycle before first study intervention administration and continuing for at least 3 months after the end of systemic exposure of the study intervention. Female participants must not donate ova for at least 3 months after the end of systemic exposure of the study intervention. Female participants who are documented as being of non_childbearing potential as defined in Section 10.4 are exempt from contraception requirements.

data.name: Informed consent capability
data.text: Participants capable of giving signed informed consent, which includes compliance with the requirements and restrictions listed in the ICF and in this protocol.

data.name: Decompensated cirrhosis or high MELD score
data.text: Decompensated cirrhosis or model for end_stage liver disease (MELD) score > 13.

data.name: High modified Nazer score
data.text: Modified Nazer score > 7 (Dhawan, 2005).

data.name: Recent gastrointestinal bleed
data.text: Clinically significant gastrointestinal bleed within past 3 months.

data.name: Elevated ALT
data.text: Alanine aminotransferase (ALT) > 2 × upper limit of normal (ULN).

data.name: Marked neurological disease
data.text: Marked neurological disease requiring assistance with self_care or activities of daily life.

data.name: Low hemoglobin
data.text: Hemoglobin less than lower limit of the reference range for age and sex.

data.name: Active viral infection or HIV seropositivity
data.text: Active infection with hepatitis B virus (positive hepatitis B surface antigen) or C virus (participants with positive hepatitis C antibody result would require confirmation of active disease with a positive hepatitis C polymerase chain reaction test), or seropositivity for human immunodeficiency virus (HIV).

data.name: Significant medical history or current disorder
data.text: History or presence of/significant history of or current cardiovascular, respiratory, hepatic, renal, gastrointestinal, endocrinological, hematological, or neurological disorders, or psychiatric disorder that in the opinion of the Investigator may constitute a risk when taking the study intervention; or may interfere with the interpretation of data.

data.name: Prior ALXN1840 or tetrathiomolybdate treatment
data.text: Previous treatment with ALXN1840 or other form of tetrathiomolybdate within 1 year prior to dosing.

data.name: Prior zinc treatment
data.text: Previous treatment with zinc within 21 days prior to Day 1.

data.name: Recent experimental or unapproved therapy
data.text: The use of an experimental or unapproved/unlicensed therapy at the same time or within 90 days or 5 half_lives, whichever is longer, prior to the Screening Visit.

data.name: Renal failure
data.text: Participants in renal failure, defined as in end_stage renal disease on dialysis (chronic kidney disease [CKD] stage 5) or creatinine clearance < 30 mL/min (Levey, 2006).

data.name: Pregnancy or breastfeeding
data.text: Pregnant (or females who are planning to become pregnant) or breastfeeding females (women of childbearing potential must have a negative serum pregnancy test result at screening).

data.name: Known sensitivity to ALXN1840 or excipients
data.text: Known sensitivity to ALXN1840, ALXN1840 excipients (anhydrous dicalcium phosphate, anhydrous sodium carbonate), or any of the ingredients contained in ALXN1840 or related compounds.

data.name: Likely non_compliance or uncooperativeness
data.text: In the opinion of the Investigator, the participant and/or their legal guardian is likely to be non_compliant or uncooperative during the study.

data.name: History of illicit drug or significant alcohol abuse
data.text: History of illicit drug abuse, history of significant alcohol abuse within 1 year prior to the Screening Visit, or clinical evidence of substance and/or alcohol abuse within the 2 years before screening. Alcohol abuse is defined as regular weekly intake of more than 14 units (for both males and females), using the following National Health Service (NHS) alcohol tracker http://www.nhs.uk/Tools/Pages/drinks_tracker.aspx.

data.name: Positive urine drug toxicology screen
data.text: Positive urine drug toxicology screen at Screening or on Day _8 (cannabinoids will not be tested).

data.name: Recent alcohol consumption or positive alcohol breath test
data.text: Alcohol consumption within 48 hours prior to study intervention administration or positive alcohol breath test at screening or on Day _8.

data.name: Unwillingness to complete every meal and tolerate controlled menu
data.text: Participants unwilling to consistently complete every meal and tolerate a controlled, limited menu for the duration of the study.

data.name: Primary Efficacy Objective
data.text: Assess net copper balance with daily repeat_dose ALXN1840 treatment (15 mg and 30 mg) in participants with Wilson disease (WD)

data.name: Secondary Copper Balance Change Objective
data.text: Assess change in copper balance in response to ALXN1840 15 mg/day and 30 mg/day during ALXN1840 accumulation and at steady state periods versus the pretreatment baseline in participants with WD

data.name: Secondary Copper Disposition Objective
data.text: Investigate the effect of ALXN1840 (15 mg/day and 30 mg/day) on the disposition of copper in participants with WD

data.name: Secondary Molybdenum Disposition Objective
data.text: Investigate the effect of ALXN1840 on the disposition of molybdenum at steady state at 15 mg/day and 30 mg/day in participants with WD

data.name: Secondary Molybdenum Balance Objective
data.text: Assess steady_state total molybdenum balance as a measure of ALXN1840 15 mg/day and 30 mg/day in participants with WD

data.name: Secondary Molybdenum Accumulation Objective
data.text: Assess accumulation of molybdenum with ALXN1840 treatment at 15 mg/day and 30 mg/day in participants with WD

data.name: Secondary Pharmacokinetic Objective
data.text: Determine the steady_state plasma pharmacokinetic (PK) of total molybdenum and plasma ultrafiltrate (PUF) molybdenum (as surrogate measures of ALXN1840, 15 mg and 30 mg) in participants with WD

data.name: Safety and Tolerability Objective
data.text: Evaluate the safety and tolerability of repeated_dose administration of ALXN1840 15 mg/day and 30 mg/day in participants with WD

data.name: Exploratory Dose Response Objective
data.text: Determine dose response of ALXN1840 15 mg/day and 30 mg/day for copper balance in participants with WD

data.name: Exploratory Treatment Duration Objective
data.text: Determine the effect of treatment duration on copper balance in participants with WD

data.name: Exploratory Ceruloplasmin and Copper Profiles Objective
data.text: Assess the effects of ALXN1840 on ceruloplasmin, ceruloplasmin_bound copper LBC profiles in plasma in participants with WD

data.description: bis_choline tetrathiomolybdate (formerly WTX101), a novel copper binding agent for the treatment of Wilson disease. Administered as 15 mg/day for approximately 28 days (Day 1 through Day 28), then titrated to 30 mg/day (Day 29 through Day 39).

Enrollment Definition
data.description: Definition of an enrolled participant
data.text: 'Enrolled' means all participants who sign the informed consent form (ICF), are eligible for the study, and are registered on Day _7 when participants are assigned a participant number.

data.name: SRC Safety Review Before Dose Titration
data.description: Safety Review Committee gate prior to up_titration to 30 mg/day on Day 29
data.text: Before titration to 30 mg/day, the Safety Review Committee (SRC) will review available safety data through Day 23 for each participant.

data.name: Safety Concern Restricting Dose Escalation
data.description: Participants may remain on 15 mg/day if escalation poses undue risk
data.text: Dosing will be initiated at 15 mg once daily for a minimum of 4 weeks, with an increase to 30 mg after 4 weeks, unless there are safety concerns that, in the opinion of the Investigator(s) and/or Alexion, may place participants at undue risk, in which case participants may remain on the 15 mg/day dose for the duration of the study.

data.name: Hepatic Dose Modification Criterion (Bilirubin with ALT)
data.description: Liver injury laboratory criterion triggering temporary interruption
data.text: Bilirubin > 2 × ULN accompanied by ALT > 3 × ULN, indicative of liver injury: temporary interruption of ALXN1840 with weekly repeat testing.

data.name: Neutrophil Decline Dose Modification Criterion
data.description: Hematologic criterion triggering dose reduction
data.text: > 30% decrease from baseline in neutrophils with neutrophils below reference range at baseline: reduce dose to previous dose level if up_titration has occurred, or reduce dose to 15 mg QOD if on 15 mg QD; no further dose increase until resolution of abnormality; weekly repeat testing.

data.name: Neurological Worsening Condition
data.description: Evidence of neurologic worsening requiring dose decision
data.text: Evidence of neurologic worsening by AEs or by neurologic physical exam assessment: Investigator and Alexion Medical Monitor will evaluate the need for dose modification (interruption, increase or decrease) based on copper control parameters and relevant clinical data; rationale must be documented and re_evaluated at the next study visit.

data.name: Psychiatric Worsening Condition
data.description: Clinically significant acute psychiatric worsening requiring dose decision
data.text: Evidence of clinically significant acute psychiatric worsening which may include but is not limited to suicidality, acute depression, or psychosis: Investigator and Alexion Medical Monitor will evaluate the need for dose modification (interruption, increase or decrease).

data.name: Rechallenge Conditions
data.description: Limits and conditions for rechallenge after dose interruption
data.text: A maximum of 3 rechallenges will be allowed. Rechallenge after bilirubin_related interruption occurs at 15 mg QOD or less frequent dosing when bilirubin is below ULN and requires approval of the Alexion Medical Monitor. Participants who were on 15 mg QOD should be rechallenged at the 15 mg QOD dose. The Investigator, in consultation with the Medical Monitor, may change dose and dose frequency in participants who require rechallenge.

data.name: Recovery Condition for Dose Re_escalation
data.description: Hemoglobin and platelets returned to baseline concentration permits resumption/rechallenge
data.text: Rechallenge when parameters (hemoglobin and platelets) are at baseline concentration.

data.name: Adaptive Design Features
data.description: Investigator_implemented adaptive features without protocol amendment
data.text: This study incorporates the use of an adaptive design. Adaptive features may be implemented at the discretion of the Investigator to support conduct of the study. Such adaptive features do not require amendment of the protocol. Adaptive features and their limits are described in Table 4.

data.name: Extended Inpatient Stay Condition
data.description: Participants may remain in CRU instead of outpatient discharge
data.text: At the CRU's discretion, participants may remain in the CRU during the outpatient period for safety or to maintain the integrity of the conduct of the study.

data.name: Pregnancy Test Eligibility Condition
data.description: Negative pregnancy test required before enrollment of women of childbearing potential
data.text: Women of childbearing potential should only be enrolled after a negative serum pregnancy test result at Screening.

data.name: Diet Compliance Condition
data.description: Willingness to comply with controlled diet required
data.text: Participants unwilling to consistently complete every meal and tolerate a controlled, limited menu for the duration of the study are excluded; participants remain on a copper/molybdenum_controlled diet throughout inpatient Period 1 (Day _8 to Day 9) and inpatient Period 2 (Day 23 to Day 40).

data.name: Clinically Significant ECG/QTcF Finding Condition
data.description: Post_enrollment clinically significant finding requires continuation assessment
data.text: If a clinically significant finding is identified (including, but not limited to, changes from baseline in QTcF) after enrollment, the Investigator or qualified designee will determine if the participant can continue in the study and if any change in participant management is needed.

data.name: Drug/Alcohol Screen Condition
data.description: Toxicology and alcohol testing at Screening and Day _8
data.text: Positive urine drug toxicology screen at Screening or on Day _8 (cannabinoids not tested), or positive alcohol breath test at Screening or on Day _8, excludes the participant.

data.name: US Screening_Only Site Condition
data.description: Sites in the US may perform screening procedures only
data.text: Text applicable only to the US details the possibility for sites in the US to only perform screening procedures and not any of the remaining study procedures.

data.name: Lost to Follow_up Condition
data.description: Definition and required contact attempts before declaring lost to follow_up
data.text: A participant will be considered lost to follow_up if he or she repeatedly fails to return for scheduled visits and is unable to be contacted by the study site. Before a participant is deemed lost to follow_up, the Investigator or designee must make every effort to regain contact (where possible, 3 telephone calls and, if necessary, a certified letter to the last known mailing address).

data.name: Screening to Enrollment/Run_in Transition
data.text: Participants eligible for the study will be enrolled on Day _7 (registered and assigned a participant number) and initiated on a copper_ and molybdenum_controlled diet; participants are admitted to the CRU on Day _8. Eligibility requires meeting all inclusion criteria and no exclusion criteria, including negative serum pregnancy test (women of childbearing potential), negative urine drug screen and alcohol breath test at Screening and Day _8, zinc washout ≥ 21 days prior to Day 1, and chelator discontinuation approximately 4 days prior to ALXN1840 initiation.

data.name: Run_in to Treatment Period 1 Transition
data.text: Following the Run_in Period (Day _7 through Day _1, including baseline copper/molybdenum balance collection Day _4 through Day _1), participants are administered ALXN1840 15 mg/day starting on Day 1.

data.name: Inpatient Period 1 to Outpatient Period Transition
data.text: Participants may be discharged from the CRU on Day 9 to the Outpatient Period, or remain in the CRU for their own safety or to maintain the integrity of the conduct of the study. During the Outpatient Period participants confirm dosing via SMS text messaging.

data.name: Outpatient Period to Inpatient/Treatment Period 2 Transition
data.text: Participants who were discharged will be re_admitted on Day 22 or Day 23 (predose) and remain in house until Day 40; all procedures will start on Day 23. The Outpatient Period may be extended up to an additional 14 days with Investigator approval, with additional investigational product provided; the actual Outpatient Period duration will be recorded and the participant will continue Inpatient Period 2 at Day 23.

data.name: Dose Escalation from 15 mg/day to 30 mg/day
data.text: Participants receive ALXN1840 15 mg/day Day 1 through Day 28 and increase to 30 mg/day on Day 29 through Day 39, after SRC review of available safety data through Day 23 for each participant and provided no safety concerns place the participant at undue risk.

data.name: End of Treatment to End of Study Visit Transition
data.text: Following completion of both inpatient periods (ie, Day 40), participants transition to previously discontinued therapy, other standard of care therapy, or preapproval access ALXN1840; all participants should return to the CRU for the EOS Visit on Day 54 (+/_ 2 days).

data.name: Dose Reduction for Neutrophil Decline
data.text: > 30% decrease from baseline in neutrophils with neutrophils below reference range at baseline: reduce dose to previous dose level if up_titration has occurred or reduce to 15 mg QOD if on 15 mg QD; no further dose increase until resolution of abnormality; weekly repeat testing.

data.name: Temporary Dose Interruption for Hyperbilirubinemia/Liver Injury
data.text: Bilirubin > 2 × ULN accompanied by ALT > 3 × ULN indicative of liver injury: temporary interruption of ALXN1840 with weekly repeat testing; rechallenge at 15 mg QOD or less frequent when bilirubin is below ULN and with Alexion Medical Monitor approval.

data.name: Dose Modification for Neurologic or Psychiatric Worsening
data.text: For neurologic worsening (AEs or neurologic exam) or clinically significant acute psychiatric worsening (including suicidality, acute depression, or psychosis), the Investigator and Alexion Medical Monitor will evaluate the need for dose interruption, increase, or decrease based on copper control parameters and relevant clinical data; rationale documented and re_evaluated at the next study visit.

data.name: Discontinuation of Study Intervention for Safety Events
data.text: Participants must be considered for discontinuation from study intervention if any of the following occur: serious hypersensitivity reaction; severe uncontrolled infection; use of disallowed medication; pregnancy or planned pregnancy; or Alexion or the Investigator deems it necessary for the participant.

data.name: Discontinuation of Study Intervention for Abnormal Liver Function
data.text: Discontinuation of study intervention for abnormal liver function should be considered by the Investigator when a participant meets one of the conditions outlined in the Dose Modification criteria (Section 6.6) or if the Investigator believes it is in the best interest of the participant.

data.name: Continued Safety Follow_up After Intervention Discontinuation
data.text: If the study intervention is definitively discontinued, the participant should remain in the study to be evaluated for safety follow_up, with data collected per the SoA at the time of discontinuation and follow_up.

data.name: Withdrawal from Study at Participant or Investigator Decision
data.text: A participant may withdraw from the study at any time at his/her own request, or may be withdrawn at any time at the discretion of the Investigator for safety, behavioral, compliance, or administrative reasons. The participant will be permanently discontinued both from the study intervention and from the study at that time.

data.name: Early Termination / Early Discontinuation Visit
data.description: At the time of discontinuation from the study, if possible, an early discontinuation visit (EOS/ET Visit) should be conducted as shown in the SoA, including a full physical examination; the reason for discontinuation must be recorded in source documents and CRF.

data.name: Study Completion
data.description: A participant is considered to have completed the study if he/she has completed all phases of the study including the last scheduled procedure shown in the Schedule of Activities (EOS Visit on Day 54 +/_ 2 days). The end of the study is the date the last participant completes the last visit shown in the SoA.

data.name: Lost to Follow_up
data.description: If the participant repeatedly fails to return for scheduled visits and cannot be contacted after documented attempts (where possible 3 telephone calls and a certified letter), he/she will be considered to have withdrawn from the study.

data.name: Withdrawal of Consent
data.description: Participant withdraws consent at any time at his/her own request; if consent for disclosure of future information is withdrawn, Alexion may retain data collected before withdrawal, and the participant may request destruction of untested samples.

data.name: Discontinuation Due to Pregnancy
data.description: Pregnancy or planned pregnancy requires the participant to be considered for discontinuation from study intervention.

data.name: Use of Disallowed Medication
data.description: Use of disallowed medication (prescription medications within 14 days or 5 half_lives, or nonprescription drugs/vitamins/supplements within 7 days or 5 half_lives before Day _7 and until completion of the follow_up visit) requires consideration for discontinuation of study intervention.

data.name: Study or Site Termination by Sponsor or Investigator
data.description: Alexion may close the study site or terminate the study at any time for any reason (eg, protocol noncompliance, inadequate recruitment, discontinuation of further study intervention development); the Investigator may initiate site closure with reasonable cause and sufficient advance notice. A site is considered closed when all participants have completed the end of study or early discontinuation visit, all data are entered, documents/supplies collected, and a closure visit performed.

data.name: SRC Titration Decision
data.description: Before titration to 30 mg/day on Day 29, the Safety Review Committee reviews available safety data through Day 23 for each participant; if safety concerns exist, participants may remain at 15 mg/day for the duration of the study.

data.name: Day 29 Dose Escalation Decision
data.description: Decision to increase ALXN1840 from 15 mg/day to 30 mg/day on Day 29 after a minimum of 4 weeks at 15 mg/day.

data.name: Day 9 Discharge vs Continued Inpatient Decision
data.description: Decision whether to discharge the participant from the CRU on Day 9 to the Outpatient Period or keep the participant inpatient for safety or study conduct integrity.

data.name: Outpatient Period Extension Decision
data.description: Investigator may approve extension of the Outpatient Period during Treatment Period 1 by up to an additional 14 days, with provision of additional investigational product; Inpatient Period 2 then resumes at Day 23.

data.name: Dose Modification Assessment at Safety Laboratory Timepoints
data.description: Review of safety laboratory results (Days _8, _1, 8, 23, 28 and weekly repeat testing) against dose modification criteria to determine dose reduction, interruption, restriction of dose increase, or rechallenge.

data.name: Neurologic/Psychiatric Dose Decision
data.description: Investigator and Alexion Medical Monitor decision on dose interruption, increase, or decrease for neurologic or psychiatric worsening, re_evaluated at the next study visit.

data.name: Post_Enrollment Clinically Significant Finding Decision
data.description: Investigator or qualified designee determines whether a participant with a clinically significant finding (eg, QTcF change from baseline) can continue in the study and whether management changes are needed.

data.name: End of Study Post_Treatment Therapy Decision
data.description: At Day 40, decision to transition the participant to previously discontinued therapy, other standard of care therapy, or requested continuation of ALXN1840 under preapproval access.
